sentences.text: Shri Sushil Goswami, appearing counsel for the petitioner.
Shri Pramod Pachori, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/State.
Today the revision is listed before this Court on admission as well as for consideration on I.A.No.6770/2017.
Heard on the point of admission.
The record of the Courts below be requisitioned.
No fresh notice is necessary to the respondent as Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State has appeared.
Appearing counsel for the parties are heard on I.A.No.6770/2017 filed under Section 397(1) of the Cr.P.C, 1973 for suspension of jail sentence of the petitioner.

Petitioner was convicted and sentenced by the JMFC, Jaura under Section 16 (1) A (1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 and his sentence recorded by the trial Court for six months RI with fine of Rs.1,000/- which has been maintained by the First Additional Sessions Judge, Jaura vide judgment dated 24.08.2017.
Appearing counsel for the petitioner contends that petitioner was released on bail during the trial and his jail sentence was suspended by the lower appellate Court and there is no possibility of early hearing of this revision before this Court and fine amount has already been deposited before the trial Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the jail sentence of the petitioner be suspended.
Learned Public Prosecutor has strongly opposed this prayer of suspension of jail sentence of the petitioner.

After considering the the rival contention made by the parties and looking to the facts that the petitioner was released on regular bail during the trial and jail sentence was suspended by the lower appellate Courts and there is no possibility of early hearing of this revision, thus, I.A.No.6770/2017 is allowed and it is ordered that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.40,000/- (Rupees Forty Thousand only) by the petitioner-Narayan Das with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, his jail sentence shall remain suspended till disposal of this revision Narayan Das vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 1 September, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68159133/
